|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/threepio.html</ref>

The golden droid has finally secured himself a new persona! [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}Threepio]] is built for [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] and Ewoks, but is handy anywhere in a pinch. Just like the real droid!

For one thing, he makes a host of you mains immune to the deploy costs of Bad feeling Have I on the same planet. [[Captain Han Solo]], [[Lando Calrissian]], [[Princess Leia]], [[Princess Leia Organa]], [[Tamtel Skreej]], [[General Solo]], Daughter of [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Skywalker]] and [[Chewbacca]] of [[Kashyyyk]]. Theres got to be something in there that takes your fancy!

His "go to Used Pile" ability is dovetailed from his role in the movies - although [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}Threepio]] seemed to always be in sticky situations, his good fortune seemed to always hold up! As far as the Imperials were concerned, he was impossible to kill! And at forfeit 5, sending him to the Used Pile may just save most of your other characters at the site.

Don't forget that there are a host of cards to help droids also!

Combos: = start a second battle this turn, and add two battle destiny!

= send [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}Threepio]] to the Used pile to cancel the last battle destiny drawn..

= reduce all opponent's battle destiny by 1.

And if that one's not good enough for you....

= NO battle destiny for your opponent.
